args.sql:
WITH EquipmentCount AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationregistry,
        COUNT(e.equipmentcode) AS equipment_count
    FROM 
        location AS l
    LEFT JOIN 
        equipment AS e ON l.loceqref = e.equipmentcode
    GROUP BY 
        l.locationregistry
),
RenewableData AS (
    SELECT 
        tswg.thermalpowerref,
        SUM(rm.wind.output_w) AS total_wind_output,
        SUM(rm.solar.output_w) AS total_solar_output
    FROM 
        thermalsolarwindandgrid AS tswg
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::renewablemetrics, tswg.renewablemetrics) AS rm
    WHERE 
        rm.wind IS NOT NULL OR rm.solar IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 
        tswg.thermalpowerref
),
PowerData AS (
    SELECT 
        pb.powerbattregistry,
        pb.powersource,
        pb.powerconsumptionw
    FROM 
        powerbattery AS pb
),
LocationWithEquipment AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationtype,
        l.stationname,
        ec.equipment_count,
        pd.powersource,
        pd.powerconsumptionw,
        rd.total_wind_output,
        rd.total_solar_output,
        (rd.total_wind_output + rd.total_solar_output) AS total_renewable_power,
        ek.definition AS energy_classification
    FROM 
        location AS l
    JOIN 
        EquipmentCount AS ec ON l.locationregistry = ec.locationregistry
    LEFT JOIN 
        PowerData AS pd ON l.locationregistry = pd.powerbattregistry
    LEFT JOIN 
        RenewableData AS rd ON pd.powerbattregistry = rd.thermalpowerref
    LEFT JOIN 
        external_knowledge AS ek ON pd.powersource = ek.external_knowledge_name
)
SELECT 
    locationtype,
    stationname,
    equipment_count,
    powersource AS reliance_on_renewables,
    total_renewable_power,
    energy_classification
FROM 
    LocationWithEquipment
ORDER BY 
    stationname;

        powerbattery AS pb
),
LocationWithEquipment AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationtype,
        l.stationname,
        ec.equipment_count,
        pd.powersource,
        pd.powerconsumptionw,
        rd.total_wind_output,
        rd.total_solar_output,
        (rd.total_wind_output + rd.total_solar_output) AS total_renewable_power,
        ek.definition AS energy_classification
    FROM 
        location AS l
    JOIN 
        EquipmentCount AS ec ON l.locationregistry = ec.locationregistry
    LEFT JOIN 
        PowerData AS pd ON l.locationregistry = pd.powerbattregistry
    LEFT JOIN 
        RenewableData AS rd ON pd.powerbattregistry = rd.thermalpowerref
    LEFT JOIN 
        external_knowledge AS ek ON pd.powersource = ek.external_knowledge_name
)
SELECT 
    locationtype,
    stationname,
    equipment_count,
    powersource AS reliance_on_renewables,
    total_renewable_power,
    energy_classification
FROM 
    LocationWithEquipment
ORDER BY 
    stationname;
